title: 佣兵小队自走棋 Mercenary Squad Auto Chess
description:
New friends, welcome to Masa's tavern. In addition to drinking, you can also play our latest designed tabletop game - Mercenary Squad Auto Chess

This is a light Roguelike Auto chess game that combines Diablo Brush Equipment Elements gameplay. Recruit mercenaries from various professions with different skills to battle the battlefield and fight monsters to the death. By flashing equipment, refining entries, and matching relics, build a super strong mercenary team and be invincible on the battlefield!

                                                                                                          

                                  

This is a simple and easy to understand game that doesn't require many beginner tutorials. With classic RPG elements, you can understand it right away. Recruit mercenaries, drag them onto the battlefield, and then start fighting. If there are enough coins, upgrade the store or recruit new mercenaries. If you can't defeat them, upgrade your equipment or replace it with higher quality or better equipment. No need to use too much brainpower, this is just a light Roguelike cultivation type auto chess game!
